name: Disheartening Display
prerequisites: Dazzling Display, Weapon Focus, base attack bonus +6, proficiency with chosen weapon
benefit:
When you successfully use Dazzling Display against any shaken, frightened, or panicked opponents, their fear increases by one step. An already panicked creature demoralized by this feat cowers. Once affected by this feat, a creature cannot be affected by it again (by you or anyone else) for 24 hours.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 118
When you affect a creature with this feat, you can spend 5 stamina points to gain the ability to affect that creature with this feat a second time during the same 24-hour period.
flavor: Your show of prowess further demoralizes others.
